description: List TaScan projects in the organization (each with its number, e.g. P-00001, external_refs, report_options and its calendar_url, webcal_url, map_url and wallet_pass_url). Optional filters: status (exact, comma list), number (exact), ref (matches any external_refs[].ref exactly, e.g. a customer job number like P14-4680), and the portal's date filters: starts_after / ends_before (YYYY-MM-DD) and window (week = Sunday-Saturday, or month) on the project's start/end dates (one date = that day; none = its created day), in zone (an IANA zone; default the org time zone, else UTC).

ends_before.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only projects whose dates end before this day

number.description: Only the project with this project number (exact, e.g. P-00012)

ref.description: Only projects whose external_refs carry this ref (exact, e.g. P14-4680)

starts_after.description: YYYY-MM-DD: only projects whose dates start after this day

status.description: Only projects with this status (exact; comma-separated list allowed, e.g. "active,archived")

window.description: Only projects overlapping this week (Sunday-Saturday) or this calendar month

zone.description: IANA time zone for the date filters, e.g. America/Los_Angeles (default: the org time zone)

name: tascan_list_projects
